extracted.name: Roasted Pumpkin Seeds
extracted.description: This roasted pumpkin seeds recipe turns a handful of seeds into a crispy, delicious snack with just butter and salt, which you likely already have.
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees F (150 degrees C).
Toss seeds in a large bowl with the butter and salt. Spread in a single layer on a baking sheet; bake until golden, stirring occasionally, about 45 minutes.
